name: Contentish Config
description: Mark config to be ignored for config-sync.
project_description: Contentish Config lets you flag individual config entities as "contentish" (site-specific, treated more like content) via a per-entity third-party setting, so they are excluded from configuration import/export. It hooks the core config-sync transform events (config.transform.export/import): on export, contentish config names are removed from the export storage; on import, their current active values are written back into the incoming storage so a deployment neither exports nor overwrites them. Config whose machine id starts with "_content_" is treated as contentish by default. This documents the 2.0.x development branch.
